text: Election of the Chair for the Property Standards Committee, Scarborough Panel under Municipal Code Chapter 27, Council Procedures, Appendix A2, for the appointed Term of Office ending October 26, 2026, and until a successor is elected.
The Property Standards Committee, Scarborough Panel: 1. Elected Jan Seaborn as the Panel Chair for a term of office expiring October 26, 2026, and until a successor is elected.
